title: Build a context that preserves the decision
description: Allocate a finite window among protected content, history, retrieved evidence, and the answer. Fitting is necessary; preserving the right information is the real objective.

policies.label: Keep recent history first
policies.detail: Preserve the newest conversation turns, then fill remaining space with retrieved evidence.
policies.rule: Good for conversational continuity; risky when external evidence is required.

policies.label: Protect retrieved evidence
policies.detail: Admit authorized evidence before recent history, then use spare capacity for conversation continuity.
policies.rule: Fits grounded tasks when the essential evidence set is known.

policies.label: Summarize, then retrieve
policies.detail: Compress older turns into a bounded summary and spend the recovered space on evidence.
policies.rule: Preserves broad continuity but adds summary-loss and provenance risk.

scenarios.label: Support investigation
scenarios.brief: Answer from current policy, account history, and several incident records.
scenarios.successCondition: Retain at least four evidence chunks and 1,200 output tokens; recent dialogue is useful but secondary.

scenarios.label: Long planning conversation
scenarios.brief: Continue a multi-turn design where earlier constraints and unresolved decisions matter.
scenarios.successCondition: Preserve the planning commitments through a traceable summary, retain two evidence chunks, and reserve 1,600 answer tokens.

scenarios.label: Structured extraction
scenarios.brief: Extract a bounded JSON object from documents under a strict schema.
scenarios.successCondition: Keep the schema intact, retain five source chunks, and reserve enough output for the complete object.
